name: hou_mcp_shell_debug
description: Full Tier 10.4 pipeline debug node. Runs all 6 phases, gate, audit, and review for the given environment, then logs a formatted human-readable report to the Vibrante-Node log panel. Use to verify environment shell construction before wiring to FurnitureClusterBuilder.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.environment_shell import get_environment_shell_builder

class Hou_Mcp_Shell_Debug(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_shell_debug"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("environment", "string", widget_type="text", default="western_room")
        self.add_output("shell_json")
        self.add_output("environment_ready", "bool")
        self.add_output("production_ready",  "bool")
        self.add_output("grade")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        environment = (inputs.get("environment") or "western_room").strip()
        try:
            result = get_environment_shell_builder().build(environment)
            s  = result.shell
            g  = result.gate
            a  = result.audit
            rv = result.review
            bp = result.blueprint or {}

            sep = "-" * 58
            lines = [
                sep,
                f"ENVIRONMENT SHELL: {environment.upper()}",
                f"  Blueprint: {bp.get('room_width',0):.0f}m x {bp.get('room_height',0):.0f}m x {bp.get('room_length',0):.0f}m",
                f"  Floor:     {bp.get('floor_type','?')}  |  Ceiling: {bp.get('ceiling_type','?')}",
                "",
                "PHASE STATUS:",
            ]
            if s:
                for phase, status in s.phase_statuses.items():
                    lines.append(f"  [{phase:<12}] {status}")
            lines += [
                "",
                "SHELL STATE:",
            ]
            if s:
                lines += [
                    f"  floor_exists:         {s.floor_exists}  (area={s.floor_area:.1f} m2)",
                    f"  wall_count:           {s.wall_count}",
                    f"  ceiling_exists:       {s.ceiling_exists}  (h={s.ceiling_height:.1f} m)",
                    f"  enclosure_valid:      {s.enclosure_valid}",
                    f"  door_anchors:         {s.door_anchor_count}",
                    f"  window_anchors:       {s.window_anchor_count}",
                    f"  beam_anchors:         {s.beam_anchor_count}",
                    f"  door_attachments:     {s.door_attachment_count}",
                    f"  window_attachments:   {s.window_attachment_count}",
                    f"  beam_attachments:     {s.beam_attachment_count}",
                ]
            lines += ["", "READINESS GATE:"]
            if g:
                lines += [
                    f"  gate_status:   {g.gate_status}",
                    f"  severity:      {g.severity}",
                ]
                if g.blocked_systems:
                    lines.append(f"  BLOCKED: {', '.join(g.blocked_systems)}")
                for f_line in g.findings:
                    lines.append(f"  ! {f_line}")
            lines += ["", "AUDIT:"]
            if a:
                lines += [
                    f"  environment_valid:   {a.environment_valid}",
                    f"  geometry_valid:      {a.geometry_valid}",
                    f"  production_ready:    {a.production_ready}",
                ]
            lines += ["", "REVIEW:"]
            if rv:
                lines += [
                    f"  floor:      {rv.floor_score:.2f}   wall:    {rv.wall_score:.2f}",
                    f"  ceiling:    {rv.ceiling_score:.2f}   anchor:  {rv.anchor_score:.2f}",
                    f"  overall:    {rv.overall_score:.2f}   grade:   {rv.grade}",
                    f"  production_ready: {rv.production_ready}",
                ]
                for f_line in rv.findings:
                    lines.append(f"  ! {f_line}")
            lines.append(sep)
            self.log_info("\n".join(lines))

            return {
                "shell_json":        json.dumps(s.to_dict() if s else {}, sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "environment_ready": s.environment_ready if s else False,
                "production_ready":  rv.production_ready if rv else False,
                "grade":             rv.grade if rv else "F",
                "exec_out":          True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_shell_debug failed: {exc}")
            return {"shell_json": "{}", "environment_ready": False, "production_ready": False, "grade": "F", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Shell_Debug
